rows.what_the_ink_shows: The assigned image is a handwritten sheet numbered 72 at the lower left. Its upper area contains cohomological formulas and diagrams written sideways, many crossed out by long diagonal strokes. The lower upright area has a lettered list: M with integrable connection and filtration; a map M(p)^sigma -> M(p) labelled F_p and Frobenius; a real analytic bundle with an automorphism F_infinity of order 2; T (betti), a local system; T_p; and a complex comparison formula. The retained crop includes this lower list and page number 72. These visible local features agree with the assigned page.tex. Evidence: crops/8_scan073_L751_handwritten_list_page72.jpg, personally inspected.
